name: peoplelake
description: Replayable workforce ELT and historical analytics warehouse on Cloudflare Workers, Basin Pipelines, R2, Workflows, BigQuery and dbt

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker-test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.deploy:dry-run: TZ=UTC node scripts/render-wrangler.ts --state scripts/fixtures/prod-state.example.json --out wrangler.production.jsonc && TZ=UTC node scripts/predeploy-check.ts --state scripts/fixtures/prod-state.example.json && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc --env production --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.deploy:runner: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake prod deploy-runner
scripts.prod:e2e: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake prod e2e --duration 60m
scripts.eval:scenarios: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake eval scenarios
scripts.eval:freshness: TZ=UTC uv run --project pipeline peoplelake eval freshness
